1.w: And these [are] the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel defeated, and they possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the River Arnon to Mount Hermon and all the plain eastward:

2.w: Sihon king of the Amorite, who dwelt in Heshbon, ruling from Aroer which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the River, and half of Gilead, and as far as the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites,

3.w: and the plain to the Sea of Chinnereth eastward, and as far as the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea) on the east, the road to Beth-jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah.

4.w: And of Og king of Bashan (of the remnant of the Rephaim), who dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei

5.w: and reigned over Mount Hermon, and over Salcah, and over all Bashan as far as the border of the Geshurite and the Maachathite, and over half of Gilead [to] the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

6.w: Moses the servant of YHWH and the sons of Israel had struck them down, and Moses the servant of YHWH had given it [as] a possession to the Reubenite, and to the Gadite, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh.

7.w: And these [are] the kings of the country that Joshua and the sons of Israel conquered on this side of the Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon and as far as Mount Halak and the ascent to Seir, and which Joshua gave to the tribes of Israel [as] a possession (according to their divisions

8.w: in the hill country, and in the Shephelah, and in the [Jordan] plain, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the Negev—the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite):

9.w: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which [is] beside Bethel, one;

10.w: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

11.w: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

12.w: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

13.w: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

14.w: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

15.w: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

16.w: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

17.w: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

18.w: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Sharon, one;

19.w: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

20.w: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

21.w: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

22.w: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

23.w: the king of Dor in Naphath-dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

24.w: the king of Tirzah, one; all the kings [are] thirty and one.
